reasoning_content:
Let me investigate why the geocoder module isn't being installed. The issue: the openculturas_openstreetmap module depends only on ctools, key, oauth2_client — but its AddressLookup class references the geocoder.throttle service. The geocoder module is enabled in core.extension but is not a dependency of openculturas_openstreetmap. During config import, modules install in an order based on dependency graph weights. The openculturas_openstreetmap gets installed before geocoder because geocoder has lower weight/higher? Actually the error occurs when the kernel is rebuilt while openculturas_openstreetmap is being installed but geocoder hasn't been installed yet.

So the bug: openculturas_openstreetmap.info.yml is missing `geocoder:geocoder` dependency. This is likely a genuine repository bug at HEAD (838d5d0). Let me check the composer-installed distribution version vs the checked-out repo. Since the repository IS the distribution (composer.json name openculturas/openculturas-distribution), the custom modules are in profile/modules/custom.

Wait, but the profile info.yml installs geocoder and openculturas_openstreetmap modules. But during `--existing-config`, the config/sync/core.extension.yml drives installation order. The order is computed by dependency graph sort. geocoder module has no dependencies tied to openculturas_openstreetmap, so its weight might place it after openculturas_openstreetmap. Since openculturas_openstreetmap declares no dep on geocoder, the graph might put openculturas_openstreetmap in an earlier weight batch than geocoder (alphabetical? no). Actually the error occurs mid-way, meaning openculturas_openstreetmap was being installed and geocoder not yet installed.

This is a genuine bug in the checked-out commit. But is it? Maybe the intended workflow uses a different drush command. Let me check whether there's a patches or a composer patch that adds the dependency. Hmm.

Actually wait — maybe the issue is that composer install did NOT use the checked-out profile, because the profile is installed as a composer dependency `openculturas/openculturas-distribution`. Let me check web/profiles/contrib. composer.json root name is openculturas/openculturas-distribution but the root package overrides. Let me check whether the profile used by drupal is profile/openculturas (repo) or web/profiles/contrib/openculturas-profile.

The drush status said Drupal root /var/www/html/web, and profile is likely openculturas at profile/openculturas. Let me verify. Actually the profile directory is /workspace/profile with name openculturas. But composer's installer-paths put drupal-profile into web/profiles/contrib. Since root package is the distribution itself, the profile isn't reinstalled.

Let me check where the active profile lives.

action.command: cd /workspace; ls -la web/profiles/; ls -la web/profiles/contrib 2>/dev/null; echo "=== custom ==="; ls -la web/profiles/custom 2>/dev/null; echo "=== find openculturas profile ==="; find web/profiles -maxdepth 3 -name "*.info.yml" | head; echo "=== symlinks ==="; find web/profiles -maxdepth 2 -type l -ls 2>/dev/null

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace; ls -la web/profiles/; ls -la web/profiles/contrib 2>/dev/null; echo \"=== custom ===\"; ls -la web/profiles/custom 2>/dev/null; echo \"=== find openculturas profile ===\"; find web/profiles -maxdepth 3 -name \"*.info.yml\" | head; echo \"=== symlinks ===\"; find web/profiles -maxdepth 2 -type l -ls 2>/dev/null", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Locate installed profile"}
